source.name: HumaHome official website

source.rightsEvidence: Requester-attested clearance dated 2026-09-29 covers internal desktop and mobile screenshot retention, derived design prompts, and pipeline-model reference use. No source-owner grant was supplied or independently verified.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A burnt-clay navigation band sits above a full-bleed interior and oversized high-contrast headline. The opening offers one direct way to begin a guided home search. The next chapters explain the market-scan method and show a four-stage buyer journey, then alternate an asymmetrical family/property image with a large terracotta statement band. A sample personalized property selection is shown as an inbox-like report artifact, not just a conventional listing grid, before a concise conversion close. The page is about a buying-advisory process rather than broad brokerage inventory. The source's geographic, pricing, timing, and service claims do not transfer to a client.

heroGeometry.viewport: make the buyer's next step immediately legible without a long introduction

rules: reduce headline size without clipping its serif contrast
turn process steps into a vertical list
stack image and copy chapters while preserving selective offsets
keep the inquiry route visible before the footer

prohibitedPatterns: copying HumaHome identity, words, photographs, report design, local market details, prices, or exact terracotta palette
claiming a property search covers marketplaces or inventory not confirmed for the client
inventing buyer delivery times, selection frequency, access, or purchasing advice
using an inbox mockup to suggest client results that have not been verified
replacing the buyer journey with a generic listing-card wall

requiredSignatureElements.description: One concise buyer-matching promise appears over a large, contextual home scene.
The service is explained as a brief buyer journey rather than a feature-card grid.
A sample selection or property brief is shown as a designed artifact using only client-approved facts.

acceptanceChecks: The hero names the kind of buyer the client actually serves and presents a working first action.
The process section explains next steps with no invented time or service claim.
The sample property artifact uses only verified client inventory or a clearly labeled neutral placeholder.
Mobile retains the buyer journey and form without image/text collisions.
Local-market terms are grounded in the client's submitted, researched, and verified service areas.

review.notes: Official homepage identifies HumaHome as a Barcelona-area property search service for buyers and presents its process, market coverage, contact route, and sample selection format. A1 was used only to discover the direct official site. Full-page desktop/mobile captures returned HTTP 200 with no broken images, unresolved images, or page errors.
